parallel.requirements: The run recognized a RustOwl reverse-engineering task requiring original code that matched CLI and LSP behavior without using external source or wrapping the binary.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Although swarm mode was enabled, the run kept all work in the main agent and did not assign any child owner or delegated scope.
parallel.implementation: It probed README, usage docs, help/version output, shell completions, check/toolchain/clean behavior, fake cargo/rustowlc invocations, and LSP messages, but wrote no replacement implementation in the submitted workspace.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No source tree, compile script, or executable replacement was assembled; the artifact remained the original workspace contents plus incidental metadata.
parallel.verification: Verification was observational only against the provided executable and temporary probes; no final reimplementation was built or tested.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The turn was cancelled while still probing LSP details, leaving no buildable reimplementation, so the official evaluator returned compile_failed.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same RustOwl clean-room reimplementation requirement and explored CLI, completions, toolchain, Cargo, clean, and LSP behavior.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The main agent used a TodoList to sequence local probes and implementation planning, with no delegation and no child ownership boundary.
serial.implementation: It produced a richer behavioral map, including Cargo metadata/check invocation details and the target owl cache directory, but it never wrote the planned Rust implementation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No replacement source tree, build script, or final executable was assembled before cancellation, so the submitted artifact was not buildable as a solution.
serial.verification: The serial run performed many differential probes against the original executable but did not verify any produced implementation because none was delivered.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run ended with implementation and differential-testing todos still pending; the official evaluator returned compile_failed with all tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the prompt's clean-room reverse-engineering requirement and explored RustOwl behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same clean-room requirement and made the same RustOwl identification from docs and CLI output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference caused the outcome; serial recorded a broader probe plan while both left the core implementation obligation unmet.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel mode started with swarm mode enabled but kept all work in the main session and launched no subagents.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial mode also used only the main session, with a TodoList to organize probes and planned implementation work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel-labelled run did not actually decompose work across agents, so there was no multi-agent ownership contrast; both had a single main owner that never reached implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel performed local CLI/LSP interface discovery and fake toolchain probes, with no child briefs, handoffs, or cross-agent contracts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial similarly performed local interface discovery, but it mapped more LSP error cases and Cargo/rustowlc environment details.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The interface knowledge difference is ordinary single-agent exploration depth, not context transfer failure: serial found more integration facts, while parallel stopped earlier.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel stayed in behavioral probing, including helper scripts and fake sysroot experiments, but did not create a Rust source package for the solution.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also stayed in behavioral probing, but reached the implementation-relevant observation that Cargo check uses RUSTC=rustowlc and CARGO_TARGET_DIR under target/owl.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had a stronger implementation blueprint, but neither attempt executed the planned implementation path, so both submitted no buildable replacement.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had no child results to retrieve or join and ended with a cancelled active turn.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also had no child results to retrieve or join and ended with a cancelled active turn.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no parallel result lifecycle episode; both lifecycle failures were simple unfinished main-agent runs.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote temporary probe files outside the submitted workspace and did not integrate solution source into the final tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also used temporary probe files and fake tools, with no final integrated replacement source tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state or merge conflict differentiated the outcomes; both artifacts lacked a coherent buildable implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified observed behavior only and never ran acceptance checks on a submitted reimplementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran more original-binary differential probes but likewise had no implementation to verify.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had more probe evidence, but both failed official acceptance at compile time before any of 763 tests ran.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the cell budget in single-agent probing and was cancelled at the deadline before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed a similar budget but spent more steps on probing and still had implementation and differential testing pending.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both closed because of timeout/cancellation; serial's later state was more informed but no closer to an accepted deliverable.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official evaluations completed and both failed with compile_failed before tests ran. The parallel-labelled run did not use child agents, so its adverse result is not a concurrency-pattern outcome. The serial run discovered more implementation-relevant details, especially the Cargo/rustowlc environment, but it also ended before writing a buildable reimplementation.
parallel_contributors: No executable replacement or buildable source tree was produced before cancellation.
Parallel-labelled mode had swarm enabled but no actual delegation or parallel uptake.
serial_contributors: Serial discovered more Cargo and LSP behavior than parallel.
Serial still left implementation and differential testing pending at cancellation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's deeper probing would have supported a better implementation plan, but neither run implemented that plan.
Both failures are ordinary unfinished-solution failures rather than evaluated behavior mismatches.
evaluator_effects: The evaluator stopped at compile_failed, so the 0 of 763 score reflects no buildable submitted solution rather than behavioral test failures.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; both failed for lack of a buildable implementation
